result.card: This PR modifies Windows CI (.github/ci-windows.py) to build in a directory with spaces (build_ _) and sets VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR. The goal is to detect bugs in subprocess and path handling on Windows that do not get caught on Linux due to symlink resolution. The PR immediately triggered a known bug in wallet_signer.py where spaces in the mock signer path fail execution, leaving CI red. hebasto provided a Concept ACK, but the PR remains a draft awaiting a fix for the underlying path-handling bug.
